referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes the most important materials, the transportation of the parts to the assembly plant and of the hydraulic digger to the end-user. Also included is the requirement of electricity and heating energy. No disposal is included as it is assumed that all materials used in the machine are 100% recycled.
